analysis:
All three changed files are documentation under docs/architecture; no executable source is in this batch. Documentation changes:
- model-registry.md (head 17-22) describes a ModelMediaPolicy.advertisesMedia guard. Staged nemotron_h_omni checkpoints stop advertising media support, which reduces attack surface. It matches the architecture string case- and whitespace-insensitively and is independent of repo IDs and aliases. Its implementation file (ProviderCoreFoundation/ModelMediaPolicy.swift) was not supplied, so the behavior is unverified.
- prefix-cache.md (head ~295-306) extends the resident recurrent checkpoint bank gate to the plain unpublished Nemotron Super owner. It introduces alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks, so checkpoints are captured only at multiples of the fixed prefill chunk. This is relevant to T-041 (cross-tenant prefix-cache and TTFT oracle). The bank is opt-in via DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY and is keyed by cacheSalt. The unchanged text still says the bank writes no recurrent state to disk. Whether the Super owner's bank also uses the SSD tier is not documented here.
- inference.md (head 25-171, patch truncated; the supplied text covers only head 1210-1352) documents the unregistered NemotronSuperLocalBridgeBuilder and says it exposes no HTTP route. It also says prompt-cache keys, media, and tools are rejected, which is a conservative posture. Its unchanged lines still say the bridge does not start a local endpoint and does not change routing.

I found no concrete security regression. Source for NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache, the cacheSalt tenant scoping on the new bank, and the buffer lifetime handling was not supplied. A later pass should check, in the code PR if it exists, that the Super bank enforces authenticated cacheSalt scoping and does not widen the SEC-035 oracle. T-041 may merit a note that the new model adds no new at-rest artifact.
